parameters.query:
WITH exact_match AS (
  SELECT v.brand AS vehicle_brand, v.model AS vehicle_model,
         v.year_start, v.year_end, v.roof_type,
         p.sku AS fitment_sku, p.name AS product_name, p.category AS product_category,
         fmap.store_product_code,
         tps.title AS store_title, tps.price_amount, tps.currency, tps.stock_status, tps.promo_text, tps.image_url,
         vpf.fitment_notes, vpf.pad_type,
         'exact' AS match_type
  FROM vehicles v
  JOIN vehicle_product_fitment vpf ON vpf.vehicle_id = v.id
  JOIN products p ON p.sku = vpf.product_sku
  LEFT JOIN fitment_store_sku_map fmap ON fmap.fitment_sku = p.sku
  LEFT JOIN tecbite_product_state tps ON tps.product_sku = fmap.store_product_code AND tps.is_active = true
  WHERE vpf.is_compatible = true
    AND ($1 = '' OR v.brand ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
    AND ($2 = '' OR v.model ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
    AND ($3::int IS NULL OR (v.year_start <= $3::int AND (v.year_end >= $3::int OR v.year_end IS NULL OR v.year_end >= 9999)))
  LIMIT 6
),
fuzzy_match AS (
  SELECT v.brand AS vehicle_brand, v.model AS vehicle_model,
         v.year_start, v.year_end, v.roof_type,
         p.sku AS fitment_sku, p.name AS product_name, p.category AS product_category,
         fmap.store_product_code,
         tps.title AS store_title, tps.price_amount, tps.currency, tps.stock_status, tps.promo_text, tps.image_url,
         vpf.fitment_notes, vpf.pad_type,
         'fuzzy_year' AS match_type
  FROM vehicles v
  JOIN vehicle_product_fitment vpf ON vpf.vehicle_id = v.id
  JOIN products p ON p.sku = vpf.product_sku
  LEFT JOIN fitment_store_sku_map fmap ON fmap.fitment_sku = p.sku
  LEFT JOIN tecbite_product_state tps ON tps.product_sku = fmap.store_product_code AND tps.is_active = true
  WHERE vpf.is_compatible = true
    AND ($1 = '' OR v.brand ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%')
    AND ($2 = '' OR v.model ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exact_match)
  LIMIT 6
)
SELECT * FROM exact_match
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fuzzy_match
ORDER BY price_amount ASC NULLS LAST;
